data.text: Litematica 0.29.1 / MaLiLib 0.30.2 (26.3) + Iris 1.11.7: both IrisCompat.registerPipelines() run from the RenderPipelines <clinit> mixin before IrisCompat.register() sets isIrisLoaded, so assignPipeline is skipped -> Iris "Missing program litematica:pipeline/legacy/translucent" etc.; ghost blocks drawn with Iris-extended vertex data via vanilla pipeline = stretched dark garbage, overlays invisible. Fix: ~/dev/masa-iris-bridge (javac build.sh, test passes) re-calls register()+registerPipelines() at CLIENT_STARTED; jar installed in mods. Gotcha: running tests with MC jar on classpath from the profile cwd makes log4j write/roll profile logs/latest.log (build.sh now cds into build/). Gamma Utils: Iris screenBrightness = options.gamma (15.0 at 1500%); Toon mac pack v3 adds GAMMA_LIFT = clamp((sb-1)/4,0,1)*0.8 as light floor in lighting/gear/water.
